title: Criteria for Design of Lined Canals and Guidance for Selection of Type of Lining
clause_1_scope: This standard lays down design criteria tor lined canals and presents guidelines for selection of type of lining.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Under-drainage of lined canals - Code of practice
Code of practice for stability analysis of earth dams
Guidelines for Lining of Canals in Expansive Soils

clause_3_terminology: Criteria for Design of Lined Canals and Guidance for Selection of Type of Lining

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
